_meta.principle: Human authors contracts; the gate ratifies. enforced_by=NONE is a VISIBLE gap, never silent. New gap or OK-contract-regression => RED.
_meta.status_legend: OK=specified+enforced | PARTIAL=partial enforcement | GAP=known blind spot (enforced_by=NONE)
_meta.source: Hand-authored backend/security invariant registry, ratified by pusk_contract_gate.py.

contracts.requirement: JWT validation must reject any token not signed with HMAC (HS256), preventing alg-confusion / alg:none bypass.
contracts.measure: validate(tok) ok => tok.header.alg is *SigningMethodHMAC

contracts.requirement: The JWT service must refuse to construct with an empty signing secret (panic at startup) rather than silently signing with a zero-length key.
contracts.measure: NewJWTService(secret,_) => secret != ""  (else panic)

contracts.requirement: AuthRequired must return 401 and not call the next handler when the token is missing or fails validation.
contracts.measure: next called => tokenStr != "" AND jwt.Validate(tokenStr) ok

contracts.requirement: AuthRequired must reject a token whose OrgID no longer resolves to a live org, so a deleted-org token cannot silently fall back to the default-org store (#153/#168).
contracts.measure: next called => orgs.Get(claims.OrgID) ok  (when OrgID != "")

contracts.requirement: AuthRequired must reject a JWT issued before its user was revoked (password change / delete), enforcing logout-everywhere within the revocation window.
contracts.measure: next called => NOT(revoked(org:uid) AND claims.IssuedAt < revokedAt)

contracts.requirement: The per-request Store must be resolved strictly from the authenticated JWT's OrgID (context or re-parsed token), never from request-controlled org parameters.
contracts.measure: db(r) = orgs.Get(claims.OrgID)  where claims = verified JWT

contracts.requirement: The global admin token must be compared with crypto/subtle constant-time comparison, never plain string equality, to prevent timing-oracle recovery.
contracts.measure: all adminToken checks use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare
contracts.note: must_contain pins subtle.ConstantTimeCompare (used at 5 sites); a plain `==` on the bearer token would fail the check. An earlier `must_not_contain: a.adminToken ==` was dropped as a false positive — it matched the legit empty-check `a.adminToken == ""`.

contracts.requirement: Global-admin-only endpoints must deny access when no admin token is configured (empty token never authenticates as admin).
contracts.measure: isGlobalAdmin/requireAdmin(token) => adminToken != ""

contracts.requirement: Org self-registration must require the global admin token in production (non-demo), preventing an anonymous client from creating the first org and receiving an admin token.
contracts.measure: registerOrg succeeds => DemoMode OR isGlobalAdmin(r)

contracts.requirement: Admin mutation handlers (createChannel, deleteChannel, registerBot, deleteBot, etc.) must pass both getOrgStore and requireAdmin before mutating, so a non-admin org member cannot mutate org config.
contracts.measure: createChannel mutates => getOrgStore(r).ok AND requireAdmin(r,s)

contracts.requirement: Each websocket connection and its presence/status fan-out must be keyed by the authenticated org so events never cross org boundaries.
contracts.measure: ws.key = claims.OrgID + ':' + userID  AND status fan-out filters by claims.OrgID prefix

contracts.requirement: Reading channel messages requires the caller to be a subscriber of that channel; non-members get 403 before any message is fetched.
contracts.measure: read(channelMessages, ch) => IsSubscribed(ch, currentUser)

contracts.requirement: Channel info (name, subscribers, pinned message) is only returned to subscribers of that channel.
contracts.measure: read(channelInfo, ch) => IsSubscribed(ch, currentUser)

contracts.requirement: The per-message read-receipt list (channelReaders) is only exposed to subscribers of the channel.
contracts.measure: read(channelReaders, ch) => IsSubscribed(ch, currentUser)

contracts.requirement: Acknowledging a channel message requires subscription AND that the target message actually belongs to that channel (no cross-channel ACK).
contracts.measure: ack(ch, msgID) => IsSubscribed(ch, user) && GetChannelMessage(msgID).ChannelID == ch

contracts.requirement: Posting a message to a channel requires the sender to be subscribed to that channel.
contracts.measure: send(ch, text) => IsSubscribed(ch, currentUser)

contracts.requirement: Reading or posting to a 1:1 bot chat requires the authenticated user to be the chat's owner; checkChatAccess compares ChatUserID against the caller.
contracts.measure: access(chat) => ChatUserID(chat) == currentUser

contracts.requirement: chatMessages must invoke checkChatAccess and bail out before fetching messages, ensuring cross-user chat reads are blocked.
contracts.measure: read(chatMessages) => checkChatAccess(chatID) == true

contracts.requirement: Outbound webhook delivery uses a dedicated client whose dialer Control hook rejects connections to loopback/private/link-local/unspecified IPs on every hop, closing the DNS-rebind TOCTOU left open by the IsLocalURL pre-filter.
contracts.measure: dial(addr) => !IsBlockedIP(resolvedIP(addr))

must_contain: Control: func(_, address string, _ syscall.RawConn) error
refusing webhook connection to internal address

contracts.requirement: sendWebhook must POST through the SSRF-validating webhookClient, never http.DefaultClient or a fresh unguarded client, so the connect-time IP check cannot be bypassed.
contracts.measure: sendWebhook(url) => transport == webhookClient (Control-guarded)

contracts.requirement: The webhook client caps redirect chains at 5 hops so a malicious redirect loop or redirect-to-internal cannot be followed indefinitely (each hop is still IP-revalidated by the dialer).
contracts.measure: redirectCount > 5 => error

contracts.requirement: The /start auto-trigger only POSTs to a bot's webhook when the URL is non-empty and not a local/internal URL, applying the SSRF pre-filter before delivery.
contracts.measure: sendWebhook(b.WebhookURL) => b.WebhookURL != "" && !IsLocalURL(b.WebhookURL)

contracts.requirement: The channelMessages limit query param is clamped to [1,200]; a non-positive limit is reset to 50 to prevent SQLite LIMIT -1 (unbounded) row dumps.
contracts.measure: limit <= 0 => limit = 50 ; limit > 200 => limit = 200

contracts.requirement: The chatMessages limit query param is clamped to [1,200]; a non-positive limit is reset to 50 to avoid SQLite LIMIT -1 unbounded reads.
contracts.measure: limit <= 0 => limit = 50 ; limit > 200 => limit = 200

contracts.requirement: Write/JSON-body routes are wrapped in limitBody, which caps request bodies at 1 MiB via http.MaxBytesReader to bound memory on decode.
contracts.measure: bodyBytes(r) <= 1<<20 for limitBody-wrapped routes

contracts.requirement: Channel message text is rejected when empty and when longer than 4096 chars, bounding stored message size at the handler.
contracts.measure: send(text) => text != "" && len(text) <= 4096

contracts.requirement: sendWebhook closes the HTTP response body on the success path to avoid connection/file-descriptor leaks on the shared webhook transport.
contracts.measure: post(url) ok => resp.Body.Close() called

contracts.requirement: X-Forwarded-For is only trusted to derive the rate-limit client key when the immediate TCP peer is loopback/private; from a public peer the real RemoteAddr is used, so a remote client cannot spoof its rate-limit identity.
contracts.measure: useXFF(r) => peerIP(r).IsLoopback() || peerIP(r).IsPrivate()

contracts.requirement: Auth, register, invite-accept, org-register and message-send routes are wrapped in RateLimit so credential-stuffing and message-flood are throttled per client IP (429).
contracts.measure: route in {auth, register, send} => handler wrapped by RateLimit(rl, ...)

contracts.requirement: Changing a user's role requires the caller to be an org admin; non-admins are rejected with 403 before any role mutation.
contracts.measure: setUserRole(target, role) => IsAdmin(currentUser)

contracts.requirement: Deleting a user requires the caller to be an org admin and forbids deleting self or the primary admin (id=1).
contracts.measure: deleteUser(target) => IsAdmin(currentUser) && target != currentUser && target != 1

contracts.requirement: markChannelRead is intentionally NOT subscription-gated: an unsubscribed org member may clear the unread badge of a channel they previously read (feature #101). Channel CONTENT (messages/info/readers/ack/send) stays subscription-gated, so no message content leaks.
contracts.measure: markChannelRead(u, ch) allowed for any org member; read(messages/info/readers, ch) => member(u, ch).
contracts.note: RECLASSIFIED 2026-06-16: an earlier read flagged the absent IsSubscribed guard as a gap, but it is by design — feature #101 shows unread badges for unsubscribed channels and clears them via mark-read; re-adding the guard breaks tests/e2e/unread-unsubscribed.spec.js. This contract guards AGAINST re-adding it. Content endpoints stay gated (see channel-message-read-requires-subscription et al.).
contracts.proof: tests/e2e/unread-unsubscribed.spec.js (#101); content gating channelMessages IsSubscribed at internal/api/client_channels.go.

contracts.requirement: Store.New must verify that foreign_keys=1 and journal_mode=WAL actually took effect, returning an error (never a usable Store) if a DSN/driver regression silently disabled them.
contracts.measure: New(path)=Ok(s) => fk(s)=1 AND (path=:memory: OR journal_mode(s)=WAL)
contracts.proof: internal/store/store.go:42 (verifyPragmas called in New before return, db.Close+return err on fail), internal/store/store.go:58 (read PRAGMA foreign_keys), internal/store/store.go:61 (if fk != 1 -> error), internal/store/store.go:70 (!EqualFold(mode,"wal") -> error)

contracts.requirement: The SQLite DSN built in New must set busy_timeout, WAL journal_mode, and foreign_keys on every pooled connection via the _pragma DSN key (the only key modernc.org/sqlite honors).
contracts.measure: dsn contains _pragma=foreign_keys(1) AND _pragma=journal_mode(WAL) AND _pragma=busy_timeout(...)
contracts.proof: internal/store/store.go:29-35 (dsn built with _pragma= keys), internal/store/store.go:34 (_pragma=foreign_keys(1)), internal/store/store.go:25-28 (comment: modernc only honors _pragma)

contracts.requirement: DeleteBot must run all dependent-row deletions (callbacks, files, messages, chats, bot) inside a single transaction so a partial failure leaves no orphaned rows.
contracts.measure: DeleteBot => atomic({del callback_queue, del files, del messages, del chats, del bots}) with rollback-on-error
contracts.proof: internal/store/bots.go:85 (tx := s.db.Begin()), internal/store/bots.go:89 (defer tx.Rollback()), internal/store/bots.go:96 (tx.Exec DELETE messages), internal/store/bots.go:99 (tx.Exec DELETE chats), internal/store/bots.go:105 (return tx.Commit())

contracts.requirement: DeleteChannel must delete channel_messages, channel_subscribers, channel_reads, and the channel itself inside one transaction with rollback on any error.
contracts.measure: DeleteChannel => atomic({del channel_messages, del channel_subscribers, del channel_reads, del channels})
contracts.proof: internal/store/channels.go:212 (s.db.Begin()), internal/store/channels.go:216 (defer tx.Rollback()), internal/store/channels.go:217-226 (tx.Exec deletes channel_messages/subscribers/reads/channels), internal/store/channels.go:229 (return tx.Commit())

contracts.requirement: DeleteUser must remove all of a user's dependent rows (subscriptions, reads, push subs, messages, chats) and the user row inside a single transaction, rolling back on any error.
contracts.measure: DeleteUser => atomic(cascade[] over channel_subscribers, channel_reads, push_subscriptions, messages, chats, users)
contracts.proof: internal/store/users.go:80 (s.db.Begin()), internal/store/users.go:84 (defer tx.Rollback()), internal/store/users.go:93 (for _, stmt := range cascade), internal/store/users.go:94 (tx.Exec(stmt, userID)), internal/store/users.go:98 (return tx.Commit())

contracts.requirement: ChannelMessages must clamp a non-positive limit to a finite default (50) because a negative LIMIT means 'unbounded' in SQLite and would return the entire table.
contracts.measure: ChannelMessages(_, limit) => effectiveLimit >= 1 (limit<1 => 50)
contracts.proof: internal/store/channels.go:162 (if limit < 1), internal/store/channels.go:163 (limit = 50), internal/store/channels.go:166 (ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?), internal/store/limit_clamp_test.go:25 (asserts len<=50 for negative limits)

contracts.requirement: ChatMessages must clamp a non-positive limit to 50 to avoid SQLite's negative-LIMIT-is-unbounded behavior dumping a whole chat history.
contracts.measure: ChatMessages(_, limit) => effectiveLimit >= 1 (limit<1 => 50)
contracts.proof: internal/store/messages.go:55 (if limit < 1), internal/store/messages.go:56 (limit = 50), internal/store/messages.go:59 (ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?)

contracts.requirement: UseInvite must consume an invite via a single conditional UPDATE that increments uses only when under max_uses and not expired, so concurrent redemptions cannot exceed the cap (no check-then-act race).
contracts.measure: UseInvite(code) consumes iff (uses<max_uses AND now<expires_at), enforced in one atomic UPDATE...WHERE
contracts.proof: internal/store/invites.go:17-20 (single conditional UPDATE uses=uses+1 WHERE uses<COALESCE(max_uses,50) AND expires_at > ?), internal/store/invites.go:24 (RowsAffected()), internal/store/invites.go:25 (if n == 0 -> diagnose)

must_contain: UPDATE invites SET uses=uses+1 WHERE code=? AND uses<COALESCE(max_uses,50) AND expires_at >

contracts.requirement: ValidateFileToken must delete (consume) the token row after a successful validation so a download token cannot be replayed.
contracts.measure: ValidateFileToken(t)=Ok => row(t) deleted (single-use); expired token also deleted and rejected
contracts.proof: internal/store/files.go:42 (SELECT user_id, expires_at FROM file_tokens WHERE token=?), internal/store/files.go:47-49 (After(expires) -> delete+reject), internal/store/files.go:51-52 (// Consume token (single-use) + DELETE), internal/store/files.go:53 (return userID, nil)

contracts.requirement: User PINs must be hashed with bcrypt before storage (CreateUser, ResetPassword) and verified via constant-time bcrypt compare (AuthUser); the raw pin must never be written to the pin column.
contracts.measure: writes to users.pin = bcrypt(pin); AuthUser uses bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword (no plaintext equality)
contracts.proof: internal/store/users.go:20 (bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword in CreateUser), internal/store/users.go:24-25 (INSERT ... VALUES (?,?,?) with string(hash)), internal/store/users.go:41 (bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword in AuthUser), internal/store/users.go:111 (ResetPassword GenerateFromPassword)
contracts.note: corrected anchor+strings to the real bcrypt calls in CreateUser/AuthUser/ResetPassword.

contracts.requirement: Every SQL statement in the store package must use ? bind parameters for caller-supplied values; no user data may be concatenated or Sprintf'd into the query string.
contracts.measure: forall query q in store/*.go: q has no fmt.Sprintf/string-concat of variables into SQL text
contracts.proof: internal/store/channels.go:47 (ChannelByName WHERE bot_id=? AND name=?), internal/store/channels.go:36 (INSERT ... VALUES (?, ?, ?)), internal/store/channels.go:166 (ChannelMessages WHERE channel_id=? ... LIMIT ?); grep across internal/store/ found zero fmt.Sprintf in SQL
contracts.note: expressed as a custom scan over all store/*.go (no Query/Exec(Sprintf|concat)) — stronger than a single-file substring.

contracts.requirement: Every store list method that iterates rows.Next() must call rows.Err() after the loop and propagate it, so a partial/truncated result set caused by a mid-iteration driver error is reported rather than silently returned as success.
contracts.measure: forall list-fn with rows.Next() loop: rows.Err() checked after loop, error returned
contracts.proof: internal/store/bots.go:45 (defer rows.Close()), internal/store/bots.go:47 (for rows.Next()), internal/store/bots.go:54-56 (if err := rows.Err(); err != nil { return nil, err }), internal/store/channels.go:73 + internal/store/users.go:61 (same pattern in other lists)

contracts.requirement: DeleteBot must refuse (return an error, no deletion) when the bot still owns channels, forcing reassignment first and preventing channels from being orphaned to a missing bot_id.
contracts.measure: DeleteBot(b) with COUNT(channels where bot_id=b)>0 => error AND no rows deleted
contracts.proof: internal/store/bots.go:79 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channels WHERE bot_id=?), internal/store/bots.go:82 (if count > 0 -> return error), internal/store/bots.go:83 (reassign them first), internal/store/bots.go:85 (s.db.Begin() only after guard passes)

must_contain: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM channels WHERE bot_id=?

contracts.requirement: setWebhook must reject webhook URLs that resolve to localhost, private, link-local, or cloud-metadata addresses before persisting them.
contracts.measure: setWebhook(url) persists => !IsLocalURL(url)

contracts.requirement: IsLocalURL must block a hostname if ANY of its resolved A/AAAA records is an internal address (DNS-rebinding A-record split protection), and must block unparsable URLs.
contracts.measure: exists ip in LookupIP(host): IsBlockedIP(ip) => IsLocalURL(host)==true

contracts.requirement: IsBlockedIP must classify loopback, private, link-local (uni+multicast), and unspecified addresses as blocked SSRF destinations.
contracts.measure: IsBlockedIP(ip) <=> ip in {loopback, private, link-local, unspecified}

contracts.requirement: All WebSocket pushes to a chat/channel user must be keyed by the org store's OrgID so messages cannot leak across tenants sharing the same numeric user id.
contracts.measure: SendToUser(key,...) => key startsWith store.OrgID + ":"

contracts.requirement: Channel-message fan-out (WS broadcast and per-subscriber push) must be scoped to the originating org store's OrgID, never broadcast globally.
contracts.measure: channelPush => SendToOrg(s.OrgID,...) AND subscriberKey startsWith s.OrgID

contracts.requirement: The off-request channel push fan-out goroutine must recover from panics so a single bad subscriber/provider cannot crash the process.
contracts.measure: go func(fanout) contains defer recover()

contracts.requirement: Every queued Update must have its UpdateID overwritten with the atomic monotonic counter so long-poll offsets never collide.
contracts.measure: Push(u) => u.UpdateID = nextID() where nextID = counter.Add(1)

contracts.requirement: Long-poll Poll must use time.NewTimer with deferred Stop (not time.Tick / time.After in a loop) so timers are released and no goroutine/timer leaks per poll.
contracts.measure: Poll uses NewTimer + defer timer.Stop()

contracts.requirement: Debouncer cleanup loop must use time.NewTicker with deferred Stop (not time.Tick) so the cleanup goroutine's ticker is released.
contracts.measure: Debouncer.cleanup uses NewTicker + defer ticker.Stop()

contracts.requirement: Webhook dedup must key on a SHA256 digest of the raw body and treat a payload as duplicate only within the configured TTL window (time.Since(t) < window).
contracts.measure: IsDuplicate(d) <=> sha256(d) seen AND time.Since(seen) < window

contracts.requirement: The webhook ingest path must wrap the request body in MaxBytesReader before reading it, bounding memory per request.
contracts.measure: webhook reads body => r.Body = MaxBytesReader(.., 2MB) precedes io.ReadAll

contracts.requirement: The POST bot-API dispatcher must cap request bodies via MaxBytesReader before routing to any method handler.
contracts.measure: dispatch => r.Body = MaxBytesReader(.., 1MB) before handler dispatch

contracts.requirement: sendMessage must reject empty text and text longer than 4096 chars before persisting.
contracts.measure: sendMessage persists => 0 < len(Text) <= 4096

contracts.requirement: Untrusted webhook payloads must only be passed as DATA to a pre-parsed template (Execute), never used as a template source (Parse), preventing template-injection; templates are parsed only from fixed const strings or local env-file paths.
contracts.measure: Render(payload) => Execute(parsedTemplate, payload) AND no Parse(payload)

contracts.requirement: The bot relay WebSocket upgrader must validate the Origin header against the request host (CSWSH protection), rejecting cross-origin Origins (only same-host/localhost/127.0.0.1 allowed; empty Origin from non-browser clients allowed).
contracts.measure: Upgrade allowed => Origin empty OR Origin.host in {reqHost, localhost, 127.0.0.1}

contracts.requirement: editMessageText and deleteMessage on a private chat must verify the bot owns the chat (ChatBotID == bot.ID) before mutating, returning 403 otherwise.
contracts.measure: editMessage(chatID) mutates => ChatBotID(chatID) == bot.ID

contracts.requirement: serveFile must require a JWT or 32-hex file-token (Authorization header or ?token=) and only serve files resolved through a store lookup; missing token returns 401 and unresolved fileID returns 404.
contracts.measure: serveFile serves path => tokenValidated AND path from store.GetFile(fileID)

contracts.requirement: Every WebSocket connection is registered in the Hub under a composite key 'orgID:userID', so connection lookup is always namespaced by org.
contracts.measure: register(conn) => hubKey == orgID + ":" + userID  (no key lacks org prefix)

contracts.requirement: SendToOrg broadcasts only to connection keys that start with 'orgID:', never to other orgs.
contracts.measure: SendToOrg(org, evt) delivers to key k  <=>  k startsWith (org + ":")

must_not_contain:
for key, conns := range h.conns {
		for _, c := range conns

contracts.requirement: Org slugs are restricted to [a-z0-9-], guaranteeing no slug contains the ':' separator, so prefix-based org matching cannot be spoofed by a crafted slug.
contracts.measure: valid(slug) => slug matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$  =>  ':' not in slug  =>  prefix(orgA+":") never matches keys of orgB

must_contain: slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

contracts.requirement: Push notifications look up subscriptions from the caller-provided org store, never a global/default store, so a user only receives pushes for subscriptions in their own org DB.
contracts.measure: SendToUser(s, uid) reads subs only from s (the org-scoped store), not a service-held store

contracts.requirement: Conn.Send must never block: on a full per-connection buffer it drops the message instead of blocking the Hub (which holds RLock during fan-out).
contracts.measure: Send(data) on full buffer => message dropped, caller returns immediately (no goroutine stall under hub lock)

contracts.requirement: All websocket writes go through the single WritePump goroutine reading from the send channel; Send only enqueues, never writes the socket directly.
contracts.measure: ws.WriteMessage called only inside WritePump (single writer) — no concurrent writes to the gorilla conn

contracts.requirement: ReadPump bounds inbound frame size (maxMsgSize) and sets a read deadline refreshed by pong, preventing unbounded-memory frames and dead-connection goroutine leaks.
contracts.measure: ReadPump => SetReadLimit(maxMsgSize) set AND SetReadDeadline(pongWait) set AND defer Unregister

contracts.requirement: When a user's last connection is removed, Unregister deletes the per-key entries from conns, status, and activeChannel maps so stale presence/state does not accumulate or leak across reconnects.
contracts.measure: Unregister(last conn) => delete(conns,key) AND delete(status,key) AND delete(activeChannel,key)

contracts.requirement: The Web Push HTTP response body is closed on both the error path and the success path, preventing connection/file-descriptor leaks under sustained push load.
contracts.measure: for each sub: resp.Body.Close() reached on err!=nil branch AND on err==nil branch

contracts.requirement: Push HTTP requests use a shared client with a non-zero Timeout, so a hung push provider cannot block the webhook-ingest goroutine indefinitely (webpush-go's default client has no timeout).
contracts.measure: PushService.httpClient.Timeout == pushTimeout (>0) and is passed as Options.HTTPClient

contracts.requirement: When VAPID is not configured (empty public key), SendToUser returns immediately without attempting unauthenticated push, avoiding errors and spurious metric noise.
contracts.measure: vapidPub == "" => early return, no webpush.SendNotification call

contracts.requirement: Push fan-out records delivery outcome (sent/failed/stale) into PushTotal, making 'did the alert reach a recipient' observable — the platform's primary function.
contracts.measure: SendToUser increments PushTotal{result} for each of sent, failed, stale after the send loop

contracts.requirement: Subscriptions that the push provider reports as gone (401/403/404/410) are deleted from the org store, preventing unbounded growth of dead subscriptions and repeated failures.
contracts.measure: resp.StatusCode in {401,403,404,410} => s.DeletePushSubscription(sub.Endpoint)

contracts.requirement: The 'default' org cannot be deleted, guaranteeing the fallback tenant (used by OrgByToken backwards-compat path) always exists.
contracts.measure: DeleteOrg("default") => error, store/dir untouched

contracts.requirement: Bot tokens (the sole credential for /bot/<token> and /hook/<token>) are never logged in full — only an 8-char prefix is emitted.
contracts.measure: slog calls referencing the bot token log token_prefix=botToken[:8], never the full token

contracts.requirement: The HTTP server's top-level handler must be wrapped in api.Recover so any downstream panic on the request goroutine is logged and turned into a 500 instead of dropping the connection / crashing the process.
contracts.measure: server.Handler == Recover(...) ; panic(downstream) => log(stack) && status==500

contracts.requirement: The Recover middleware must catch the panic, log it with a stack trace, and emit a 500 — it must not re-panic or leave the response uncommitted.
contracts.measure: recover()!=nil => slog.Error(stack) && jsonErr(500)

contracts.requirement: Async forward functions dispatched as goroutines (forwardToBot, forwardCallback) must defer recoverLog so a panic during forwarding does not kill the whole process (net/http only recovers panics on the request goroutine).
contracts.measure: go forwardToBot/forwardCallback => first stmt is defer recoverLog(name)

contracts.requirement: forwardCallback (dispatched via `go a.forwardCallback`) must defer recoverLog as the first statement so a panic on the callback-forward goroutine is contained.
contracts.measure: go forwardCallback => defer recoverLog("forwardCallback")

contracts.requirement: The inline `go func()` that forwards the synthetic /start update (calls sendWebhook) is NOT guarded by recover/recoverLog, unlike forwardToBot/forwardCallback — a panic on this goroutine would crash the process (blind spot the existing detectors miss).
contracts.measure: go func(){...sendWebhook...} SHOULD contain recover-guard but does not
contracts.note: OPEN gap: startChat's inline forward goroutine calls sendWebhook/relay.Send with NO defer recoverLog, unlike its guarded siblings forwardToBot/forwardCallback — an unrecovered goroutine panic crashes the process. live_check asserts the recover guard in startChat -> currently False (gap confirmed).

contracts.requirement: The /metrics endpoint must reject requests whose RemoteAddr is not loopback or a private/Tailscale CIDR, so Prometheus internals are not exposed to the public internet.
The process must trap SIGTERM/SIGINT and call srv.Shutdown with a bounded context so in-flight requests drain instead of being killed abruptly (container/systemd stop safety).
contracts.measure: SIGTERM|SIGINT => srv.Shutdown(ctx with timeout)

contracts.requirement: The http.Server must set ReadHeaderTimeout so a slow-header (Slowloris) client cannot pin a connection/goroutine indefinitely.
contracts.measure: http.Server.ReadHeaderTimeout != 0

contracts.requirement: The -healthcheck flag must dial the listen address and os.Exit(0/1) WITHOUT starting the server, so the scratch image's HEALTHCHECK (which has no wget) can probe via the binary itself.
contracts.measure: flag healthcheck==true => net.DialTimeout then os.Exit; never reaches ListenAndServe

contracts.requirement: Both container images must drop to an unprivileged user (USER pusk) before running the binary, so a compromise does not yield root inside the container.
contracts.measure: Dockerfile contains `USER pusk` after binary copy; never runs as root

contracts.requirement: The FSTEC scratch image must run on `FROM scratch` (no shell/package manager) as the non-root pusk user (uid 10001) carried in via /etc/passwd, with healthcheck via the binary not wget.
contracts.measure: scratch base && copies /etc/passwd && USER pusk && HEALTHCHECK uses /app/pusk -healthcheck

contracts.requirement: Demo seeding (guest user, demo bots/tokens) must live behind //go:build demo with a //go:build !demo stub, so the release binary contains no demo credentials or seed data.
contracts.measure: demo.go has //go:build demo && demo_stub.go has //go:build !demo && release build => initDemo is no-op
